approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves a population of scored molecular graphs. It draws breeders from high score quantiles, combines connected fragments or makes bounded graph mutations, and keeps the best observed survivors. A Gaussian process learns from every accepted score using counted molecular environments. Correlated posterior samples choose which members of each fresh pool receive evaluation. Stable molecular identity checks and a source-relative sulfur rule govern admission.
approach.novelty: Replace the mutation neighborhood with context-matched fragment substitution. A table built only from the permitted unlabeled molecules records which fragments occur at the same local attachment environment. Each mutation samples one current source cut and one compatible different fragment, then constructs a fresh graph at that exact attachment. This differs from the failed broad token edits, typed recombination of two scored parents and post-generation support filters. Preserving a local relationship while exchanging larger pieces may supply useful alternative connectivities; actual gains and all endpoints must establish whether it does.

observed_bottleneck: The actual code Parent n-1744a1494180 has a useful accepted-feedback count GP and correlated allocation, but recent fully delivered changes repeatedly replace absolute progress with more low-value activity. Its complete mean is 0.59645311428869 (population SD 0.03397032998399878); the later r36 joint fit n-0142fbe4db04 changes 2216/4350 accepted choices, reaches subsequent fits/breeders and lowers MSE, yet raises strict parent wins from 648 to 763 while reducing positive gain mass from 17.25153528627184 to 15.150850854195372, sequential incumbent gain from 5.819415048695714 to 5.1026183058503305 and complete mean by 0.047786449523025666. This does not identify one defective GP scalar. The actual shared mutation replacement n-700f8a4cd559 delivers 2888 accepted SELFIES-route offspring and more new typed cores (2422 versus1820), but gain mass is only10.324590 and complete mean loses0.127509460790014. Typed two-parent crossover n-55d120396e72 delivers968 evaluated products but loses0.09479254157802065; niche-breeder exposure n-37a4fc183d94 loses0.055186727444823. Broad connectivity access, supported typing, more cores and local win counts have not established productive independent alternatives. A concrete untested construction gap is exchanging multi-atom fragments while preserving a learned unlabeled local attachment relationship, retaining the useful original allocator. Local-support gate n-39a65c2978c0 supplies only different-lineage mixed single-seed contextual evidence, not transferred efficacy. Native TabPFN and the pairwise BNN/UCB recipes remain ended; the BNN has13 lower completed endpoints and2 missing endpoints, so no invented complete score. The frozen Iterative Review supports this specific uncertain test, not a diagnosis that chemical plausibility or novelty causes score.

finding_summary.headline: Context grafts reach evaluation and breeding, but useful gain shrinks and all three seed macro scores fall
finding_summary.insights:
Local context support was sufficient to construct different multi-atom graphs and carry them into accepted feedback and breeding. It was insufficient to make this fixed neighborhood more productive. Typed new-core arrivals fall to 1,058 from 1,820, and fewer of those first arrivals beat their parents or the incumbent. Generic-core first-arrival incumbent wins instead rise to 79 from 71, illustrating why a favorable novelty descriptor cannot substitute for larger realized gains. Each panel has four sessions whose ten leaders trace to a single founder, and every leading set shares at least one founder across all members. Distinct seed-leading chemistries still exist, but their overlapping ancestry does not establish independent family discovery. The late search loses especially much gain mass; the result narrows the problem to generating and developing useful alternatives, rather than merely delivering larger edits.

Both borrowed CReM elements operated: the corpus-derived context/fragment relation supplied compatible alternatives, and the canonical context keys plus mapped attachment produced the recorded accepted graphs. The result applies to the declared single-cut adapter. Its physical-site enumeration and stereo handling differ from the general upstream implementation, so this neither reproduces nor refutes the full CReM family. Chemically, fewer heteroatom-halogen attachments and no observed cyclic cumulene or ring-alkyne flags coexist with persistent reactive attachments, unspecified stereochemistry, tiny fragments and oversized assemblies. Those changes do not establish whole-molecule feasibility or explain the endpoint loss causally. Prospective prediction diagnostics improve on the different acquired stream while the GP itself remains unchanged, again separating a useful proxy from optimization progress.

The registered productive-gain and endpoint falsifiers are triggered despite confirmed construction and feedback activation. This complete exposed result ends the fixed recipe. It does not isolate the contribution of corpus size, radius, cut scope or sampling, and provides no justified parameter sweep or continuation. A materially revised approach would need new failure-specific evidence and planning; the broader constructive-fragment idea remains an open question.
finding_summary.results:
The construction mechanism operated in every session. Of 4,350 accepted offspring, 2,867 contain a changed context graft, including 2,570 with a multi-atom fragment on at least one side of the final replacement and 607 with a ring-containing incoming fragment. All 2,770 nonterminal graft products entered the next Gaussian-process fit; 2,278 were retained and 1,571 were later selected as parents. Their accepted direct-child union contains 3,056 molecules, so this was substantial exposure through the real search, not merely successful table lookup.

That exposure did not yield the predicted larger useful gains. Strict wins over the original best generating parent rise slightly, 653 versus 648, but their total positive margin falls to 15.276942 from 17.251535 and their median winning margin falls to 0.005429 from 0.007549. Sequential incumbent advances fall to 231 from 255, with total gain 5.156211 versus 5.819415. The Child also uses somewhat weaker scored parents; its less-negative average child-minus-parent margin is therefore not evidence of greater absolute progress. Positive gain mass improves in two seeds but falls overall, while incumbent progress falls in all three. The complete mean endpoint is 0.552239516 versus 0.596453114, a paired change of -0.044213598 against the required +0.002. Five of 15 endpoints improve and ten decline; all three seed macro scores decline. The Parent’s late decoration-hopping breakthrough remains fully included.

molecular.headline: Familiar aromatic and amine families remain ancestry-concentrated; reactive attachments and unspecified stereo persist
molecular.overall_character: Node n-9f11b684e560 emits familiar aromatic frameworks with varied pendant groups: substituted indoles and biindoles, coupled coumarin/azaaryl systems, polyaryl sulfones and carbonyl-rich nitrogen heterocycles, aryl-linked aliphatic amines, and fluorinated diones or imino amides. Rings, aromaticity, carbonyls and amines are abundant rather than missing. Across 4350 Child optimizer observations the heavy-atom median is 29, range 2-116; perceived-ring median is 3, range 0-14, and aromatic-ring median is 3. The Parent median is 28 heavy atoms and four perceived rings. All Child smallest-ring-set member sizes are at most seven, compared with Parent maximum thirteen; this is an RDKit ring-basis descriptor, not proof that larger composite cycles or difficult geometry are absent. Digest ring-closure-string incidences are 0.9540-0.9839 and aromatic-string incidences 0.9437-0.9805. Those are molecule-level text incidences, not atom fractions or perceived ring counts. Coverage is complete and paired: all fifteen Child and fifteen authoritative published Parent n-1744a1494180 trajectories were read, including 4500 observations per side, 4350 optimizer observations and 150 session-initial observations. Each task has 900 observations, including 870 optimizer observations; all three issued Search seeds and all five tasks are covered, no paths are missing, and the immutable comparison reports child_complete=true, paired_complete=true and no profile mismatch. Fresh RDKit 2023.09.6 calculations and emitted/observed original-parent joins were performed for every Child record. The unchanged Parent descriptors and lineage calculations were reused from the fully frozen r 36 molecular audit only after its manifest and all fifteen Parent trajectory/log hashes were verified, every one of its 4500 trajectory rows was reread and matched, and Parent source hash and current matched conditions were checked. Exact reuse provenance is in .slots/L01-resume-20261004/r37-slot0-molecular/parent_reuse_provenance.json; no prior Child metrics were reused. All 290 optimizer records per Child session have matching emitted and observed receipts with original scored parents. Final greedy 64 membership is reconstructed by score and evaluation order, cross-checked against final feedback best/mean and pending=0 on all thirty sessions; no exact retained-identity event is claimed. The output shifts chemical liabilities rather than eliminating them. Child/Parent molecule incidences per 4350 optimizer observations are N-halogen 362/786, O-halogen 102/217, S-halogen 2/93 and peroxide 150/127; classes overlap. Cyclic carbon bearing at least two double bonds is absent in Child versus 6 Parent observations, and ring alkynes are absent versus 13. These are observed graph flags, not measured stability, strain, toxicity or synthesis. In the pooled per-seed top tens, Child still has 19/150 N-halogen,5/150 O-halogen and 7/150 peroxide molecules. Sulfur occurs in 733/4350 versus 1100/4350; this neither validates a sulfur filter nor makes sulfur uniformly undesirable. Formal charge annotations appear in 218/4350 Child versus 0/4350 Parent observations, including nitro charge separation and phenolate-like anions. The flag records any charged atom, not net charge or a harmful feature. Neutral output includes basic amines; charge representation is distinct from protonation-state validity. Stereochemistry remains incompletely specified. No optimizer molecule on either side has an assigned tetrahedral centre or assigned double-bond stereochemistry. Unassigned tetrahedral centres occur in 950/4350 Child versus 2455/4350 Parent molecules; unspecified potentially stereogenic double bonds occur in 652/4350 versus 1192/4350. Child has fewer such arrangements in this sample, not a demonstrated stereo-handling improvement. RDKit potential-stereo perception is not evidence that each arrangement is configurationally stable. Canonical isomeric identities are used for accepted-history joins; nonisomeric Murcko cores deliberately group away stereo and are separate descriptors. Descriptive exploration remains uneven. Session-summed first arrivals absent from all earlier accepted records, including initials, are 1058 typed and 906 generic nonisomeric cores for Child versus 1820 and 1117 for Parent. Empty-core optimizer observations are 131 versus 111. Typed first arrivals have 209 versus 262 strict best-parent wins and 86 versus 107 sequential-incumbent wins;301/1058 versus 485/1820 first arrivals later have accepted direct children. Their within-session deduplicated direct-child unions contain 1092 versus 1791 observations, with positive best-parent-margin sums 5.431525470582473 versus 6.035552260703594. Generic first arrivals instead have 180 versus 163 parent wins and 79 versus 71 incumbent wins, demonstrating that a single diversity summary hides differences in grouping. Those totals retain session identity, include the empty core separately, and are not independent global scaffold replications. Direct-child unions are not all transitive descendants; a later molecule sharing a core need not descend from the first arrival. Across all accepted optimizer records, strict best-parent wins are 653/4350 versus 648/4350, but positive-margin sums are 15.276942412130648 versus 17.25153528627184. Mean offspring labels are 0.3700844984408235 versus 0.372049560842182 and mean original best-parent labels 0.44787186290476333 versus 0.4553040448335957. Sequential-incumbent gain sums are 5.156211073030304 versus 5.819415048695714; batch-frozen sums 8.704259533379746 versus 9.341378012076637 can count overlapping gains by multiple same-batch molecules and have a different meaning. Pooling heterogeneous score landscapes is descriptive only. Every session's top ten shares at least one initial founder; four of fifteen top-ten sets on each side have only one distinct founder, and other sets have two or three. Founder/leader-incidence HHI ranges from 1/3 to 1 on both sides; that denominator differs from ten-leader coverage. Both crossover parents are retained and founders are deduplicated within each leader. All final greedy 64 sets likewise share a founder across all 64 members. These are ancestry associations, not independent contributions or proof that all chemistry is identical. The complete supplied endpoint means remain Child 0.5522395159109963 and Parent 0.59645311428869, with seed macro deltas-0.07835599908337099,-0.014381737518478044,-0.039903058531231994. No chemical cleanup, local-win count or scaffold descriptor supersedes those observations; activation and eligibility are outside this report. Apparent synthetic plausibility is questionable overall because recognizable medicinal motifs coexist with reactive attachments, peroxide bonds, incompletely specified stereochemistry and excessive elaboration. No synthetic route, conformer, energy, assay or additional oracle was evaluated. Citation notation C(seed,task):line denotes the current .worktrees/slot-0/runs/staging/seed-{seed}/trajectories/{task}.jsonl; P(seed,task):line denotes runs/SPIRAL2/nodes/n-1744a1494180/seed-{seed}/trajectories/{task}.jsonl. All paths resolve under the project root, and evaluation equals line here. Every cited_smiles string is copied from a request-trusted Child trajectory; exact path/line/score evidence is in citation_ledger.json, with full thirty-session descriptors and lineage receipts in trajectory_audit.json. These artifacts and all read-source hashes are frozen with the report.

liabilities: N-halogen incidence falls to 3/870 from 275/870 Parent, and none of the pooled 30 top-ten molecules has an N/O/S-halogen or peroxide bond. However peroxide incidence rises to 45/870 from 7/870 across the full output; the cleaner leaders do not characterize every proposal.

transferable_gaps.gap: Familiar local fragment environments do not consistently preserve conventional bond chemistry in the complete emitted molecule.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Generation needs environment-aware alternatives preserving useful accepted functional relationships at whole-molecule scale. Distinguish peroxide from ester, thiocyanate from ordinary thioether, heteroatom-halogen from aryl halide, and net charge from charge-separated resonance notation. A locally supported fragment relation and a sulfur envelope are not synthetic-feasibility certificates. No universal exclusion rule, component attribution or guaranteed score gain follows from these associations.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
